This repository contains the source code for a UE5.8 procedural city generation project 

Repository scope:
- focus primarily on source code under `Source/`
- do not assume Unreal Engine source code is present in this repository
- do not require Engine source modifications unless explicitly requested
- assume large generated folders and binary assets are intentionally excluded from version control

When answering:
- reference exact file paths when possible
- use the repository documents as context, especially:
  - `README.md`
  - `docs/architecture.md`
- do not assume the user wants engine-level changes, but large framework rewrites can be suggested if they are clearly justified and aligned with the architectural intent
